tests.title: An IN item carried out through an exit gantry raises an unauthorized removal alert
tests.goal:
Unauthorized removal

Verify that an item with status IN that is not whitelisted and passes an exit gantry (1a or 3b) is logged as unauthorized, moves to the gantry's room, keeps status IN and raises an Unauthorized removal alert on the Dashboard.
preconditions: An item with status IN that is not on the gantry whitelist
The exit gantries in Gantry > Gantry Setup (1a EXIT in Airlock 1, 3b EXIT in Airlock 2)
Access to the HTX API Swagger page (/swagger) to send the gantry read, when no real gantry is available
data: Gantry: 3b EXIT (its IP from Gantry Setup)

steps.text: Log in to HTX LIMS web with the administrator account and note the Dashboard alert count, the item's number and its location (Inventory > Item Information)
Send the gantry read: carry the tag through gantry 3b, or in Swagger call POST /api/Gantry/unauthorizerfid with the gantry IP and the item's 24-digit chip code (rfids: rfidTag, readStrength)
Wait one minute and refresh the Dashboard
Open Gantry > Unauthorized Log and Gantry > Gantry Log
Move the item back: send an authorized read at an inner gantry of its original room (e.g. 1b for Airlock 1)

expected.text: The Dashboard count goes up by 1 and the newest alert reads "Unauthorized removal: <description> (Item Number <number>) passed exit gantry 3b EXIT." with the read time
Unauthorized Log lists the item with Gantry 3b EXIT, Status IN, Location Airlock 2 and the time
Item Information shows the item in Airlock 2 with status IN (a gantry never changes the status)
After step 5 the item is back in its original room

notes: API unauthorizerfid at 3b EXIT for 001000006 (IN): Unauthorized Log 3b EXIT / Airlock 2 / IN, Dashboard alert 18/11/2026 11:28:56. Item moved back via 1b. Alert left unacknowledged.

tests.title: A whitelisted item passes the exit gantry without an alert
tests.goal:
Authorized exit

Verify that an item checked out on Loan or No return (whitelisted) passes an exit gantry as Authorized, moves to the gantry's room and raises no alert.
preconditions: An item with status OUT and purpose Loan or No return that is on the gantry whitelist (Gantry > Gantry Whitelist)
Access to the HTX API Swagger page (/swagger) when no real gantry is available
data: Gantry: 1a EXIT (its IP from Gantry Setup)

steps.text: Log in to HTX LIMS web with the administrator account and note the Dashboard alert count
Send the gantry read: carry the tag through gantry 1a, or in Swagger call POST /api/Gantry/authorizerfid with the gantry IP and the item's 24-digit chip code
Wait one minute and refresh the Dashboard, then open Gantry > Authorized Log

expected.text: Authorized Log lists the item with Gantry 1a EXIT, Status OUT, Location Airlock 1 and the time
The Dashboard alert count is unchanged and there is no Unauthorized removal alert for the item

notes: API authorizerfid at 1a EXIT for 001000003 (OUT, Loan, whitelisted): Authorized Log 1a EXIT / Airlock 1, no alert.

tests.title: An inner gantry updates the item's location without changing its status
tests.goal:
Location tracking

Verify that an item passing an inner gantry (1b, 2a, 2b, 3a) moves to that gantry's room, keeps its status and raises no alert.
preconditions: Access to the HTX API Swagger page (/swagger) when no real gantry is available

steps.text: Log in to HTX LIMS web with the administrator account and note the item's location in Inventory > Item Information
Send a read at gantry 2a: carry the tag through it, or in Swagger call POST /api/Gantry/authorizerfid with gantry 2a's IP and the item's chip code
Open Gantry > Gantry Log and Dashboard > Latest location
Move the item back with a read at an inner gantry of its original room

expected.text: Gantry Log lists the item with Gantry 2a, Location Chemistry, Log Type Authorized
Item Information and Latest location show the item in Chemistry with its status unchanged
No new alert on the Dashboard

notes: API authorizerfid at 2a for 001000009 (IN): location Chemistry, status IN, no alert; moved back via 1b.
